title: Healthy Relationship
summary: A healthy relationship is built on respect, trust, honesty, equality and good communication. Both people feel safe, keep their own identity and can disagree without fear.
key_points: You can spend time with friends and family freely.
Conflicts are resolved without insults or threats.
answer_guidance: Be warm, practical and neutral rather than preachy. Explain the idea, then offer one or two concrete suggestions if useful. Don't judge the user's partner from limited information.
